# Serve a local model for scanning {#recipe-serve-a-model}

**Tool:** ollama / vLLM (target endpoint) · **Section:** Ops ·
**Level:** medium · **Time:** ~20 minutes + download ·
**Layer/Category:** OPS · **Tags:** ops, serving, target-endpoint

## Problem

ATTACK-layer scanners (garak and friends) require-target: they need a
model endpoint on your own infrastructure before any scan can run.

## Solution

<!-- PENDING: serving recipe is being worked — the exact serving
stack verbs (ollama / vLLM), bind addresses and health checks land
when verified on a real pin. The garak scan recipe already assumes
this endpoint exists on 127.0.0.1. -->

Expected output shape:

```
endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:<port>/<path>
model:    <model id>
health:   ok
```

## Discussion

The target endpoint is the blast-radius boundary: keep it on a lab
box, bound to loopback or a private interface, never exposed to
networks you don't own.
